title: Timeline
summary: A vertical activity feed of timeline items joined by a line.

slots.description: pk-timeline-item children, in the order to show them.

a11y: The host is role=list; each pk-timeline-item is a listitem with a real time element. State is also given in words in the heading when it matters, never by the marker colour alone.

examples.title: Order history
examples.html:
<pk-timeline label="Order history">
  <pk-timeline-item heading="Shipped" time="2026-09-16" status="done">Tracking 9400.</pk-timeline-item>
  <pk-timeline-item heading="Packed" time="2026-09-15" status="active"></pk-timeline-item>
</pk-timeline>
